protection_assumption: For the inventoried 49076-byte L1 block only: first 8 bytes in each 24-byte group protected. Protected bytes are never decoded; visibility does not establish executable instructions.
limits: Only adjacent low/high or high/low immediate pairs, aligned literal words and SDRAM relative CALL encodings are inventoried. Gapped pairs, arithmetic, aliases, general indirect calls and data flow are not reconstructed.
A low half alone or a resolved different high half is not a reference to the requested target. Full pairs and pointers remain candidates, not verified reads/writes or callers.
Relative CALL encodings may occur in data; absence of direct calls does not prove absence of a caller or an L1 dependency. No L1 instructions executed or decrypted.
A following relative call after a loaded target is separate metadata: the loaded address is not assumed to be the callee.
Input/output buffer roles, sample rate, routing, per-sample drum gain/pitch producers and scheduling remain unproven.
